natalie (sales): Quick help — Enterprise POC (tenant: beta-corp-9) demo triggered 429s during chat + embeddings section. Client reported intermittent 'rate limit exceeded' errors, demo in 20 minutes. Anyone able to triage fast?
diego (solutions-eng): Oof. Can you paste the response headers and a sample request? Likely hitting per-route burst or token budget.
natalie (sales): Headers from the browser: 
`x-rate-limit-limit: 1200/min`
`x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`
`retry-after: 3`
`X-Request-Id: rq_zxy987`
Request was many small embedding calls from the frontend (no batching) and chat turns sending long histories.
mira (eng-oncall): That remaining=0 + short retry-after smells like trial-like per-route throttling or tenant-level token budget exhaustion. Are they using the trial API key or an eval key?
natalie (sales): It's a sales trial key (beta-corp-9). They spun up a demo page where 6 browser workers fetch embeddings in parallel and also preview chat replies.
diego (solutions-eng): Short-term: 1) throttle front-end concurrency to 2, 2) implement client-side exponential backoff for 429s, 3) ops can apply a temporary per-route bump for this tenant. Which do you want?
natalie (sales): Apply a temporary bump so demo doesn't die; we'll update the demo later.
quota-bot (opsbot): Per-route quota bump applied for tenant beta-corp-9: 60 r/s until 2244676000. Ticket #4789.
mira (eng-oncall): Watching metrics now — console.redwood.ai/tenants/beta-corp-9/metrics. Also filing a follow-up: add POC guide note to use batched embeddings and limit concurrency.
diego (solutions-eng): For long-term proposal: reserved capacity or dedicated throughput and recommended client patterns (batch embeddings, stream chat with incremental updates). I'll send a pricing note.
natalie (sales): Thanks! Demo resumed, seems stable. We'll send the engineering team the batching example and retry guidance.
